method: Read the same captured 388 WB cards and all 1380 Catalog detail cards; no new API requests.
Select the 128 variants without WbRegisteredBarcode.first; isolate 114 with zero GtinCatalogIndex.attributes candidates across all Catalog states.
Diagnostic article equality uses GtinMatchingService.normalizeArticle against every observed article value, retaining values erased by CatalogProductData.single.

A has no observed normalized article value anywhere; B has article equality but no complete normalized color-set equality; C has article plus full-color equality but no GtinVariantIdentity.sizeMatches using native/Russian size; D has diagnostic full equality only through a multi-valued article that single() suppresses.
The buckets are mutually exclusive in that order; no fuzzy/model-prefix match, color dropping, size conversion or automatic assignment.
limits: An unmatched article can reflect different naming between WB and Catalog, a missing card, or another credential/account dataset. These reads cannot distinguish those explanations.
No exact match does not mean a product is unregistered.
Installed seller and certificate ownership remain unverified; diagnostic multi-value candidates do not authorize mapping or writes.
